plugins.Author: The Enceladeum
plugins.Name: HOutfits
plugins.Punchline: Apply full sets, loose pieces, facewear and weapons to your character in Glamourer with a single click.
plugins.Description: Browse the game's named sets, sets recovered by item name, every other wearable piece, facewear and weapons, with large icon previews on hover, and apply a whole set or any single piece to your character through Glamourer, instead of picking each item from a dropdown.
plugins.Changelog: 1.4.0: Dress your HDM puppets. HDM's Dress... button opens HOutfits on a puppet, and every set, piece, NPC look, face and Revert goes to it until you click Back to me (shown at the top of the window). Weapons load on a puppet for any class, and the Faces tab follows the puppet's body. HOutfits returns to dressing you when the puppet goes away or you change zone.

plugins.Author: The Enceladeum
plugins.Name: Cosmic Claw
plugins.Description: Play the Cosmic Predator's Magitek Claw Sweep animation on demand, once or on a loop, while you're riding it. Purely cosmetic and local-only; nothing is sent to the server. Works on both the Cosmic Predator and the standard Magitek Predator. Commands: /clawsweep and /clawsweeploop.
plugins.Changelog: 0.1.1: loop now repeats until toggled off; also works on the standard Magitek Predator (mount 121); tidier command help and quieter chat.

plugins.Author: The Enceladeum
plugins.Name: HMoniker
plugins.Description: Changes your display name. Local only: visible only to yourself outside of HMS (HMapSync) sessions.
plugins.Changelog: 1.5.1: fixes the "Hide status icon" toggle so it now hides the online-status icon, and makes the FC tag / name / title / status-icon toggles take effect the moment you tick them.

plugins.Author: The Enceladeum
plugins.Name: Begone!
plugins.Punchline: Out of sight, out of mind.
plugins.Description: Hide NPCs with a single click
plugins.Changelog: 0.3.0: adds a global toggle to hide the ! and ? quest markers over NPCs' heads, keeping the NPCs (cosmetic, client-side).

plugins.Author: The Enceladeum
plugins.Name: HMapSync (HMS)
plugins.Description: Load any in-game map client-side and explore it solo or with up to 20 friends, behind a packet filter that keeps the server seeing you as idle in your room. Shared weather, BGM and time; client-side mounts, emotes and minions; carpet floors for spots without collision; head-tilt and gaze sync for roleplay; and proximity say/yell passthrough. Co-op needs a relay key (closed beta); solo mode never connects to the relay.
plugins.Changelog: 1.1.0.7: puppets other players see stay right (none left behind after Despawn all, new copies appear where placed, copies return after an HDM reload); new safety check after game or Dalamud updates turns off and reports any feature whose game structures moved, instead of risking a crash.

plugins.Author: The Enceladeum
plugins.Name: HDM
plugins.Punchline: Wear any monster's face. Client-side mob disguises with a searchable catalog and animation triggers.
plugins.Description: A catalog of every mob in the game (16k+ models, 15.5k named) plus the full set of humanoid NPCs (Glamourer's NPC tab). Apply any mob's or NPC's look to yourself client-side (Brio-style ModelCharaId swap + redraw, or a Glamourer paint for humans), spawn disguised puppets, trigger action timelines for theatrics, and revert cleanly. Self-apply only, like Glamourer — never enforced on other players. Built for DM/event use — no mechanics, just the face.
plugins.Changelog: 1.0.8.0: your Penumbra mods on your puppets (Config, opt-in; others with the same mods see them too); a floating bar for you or the puppet you're working on (/hdm bar); Release from any tab while possessing; Catalog rework with puppet chips and double-click spawn; pose props taken from the game's own NPCs; spawning paced to one a second in a session.
